Mini Portfolio

Email & Social Design

My full-time work is email marketing and website management for the University of Miami's Division of Development and Alumni Relations. Outside of work, I've designed social media assets for La Cancha Tennis, a local tennis business, and GradOUT, a graduate student organization on campus.

Email Marketing

Responsive, accessible templates built in Salesforce Marketing Cloud: rebuilt from dated originals with clearer hierarchy, on-brand color, and a single obvious next step.

Centennial Birthday Email

Alumni Outreach

Regional Engagement Outreach

A scalable event invitation template that balances regional personalization with a cohesive university brand. It streamlined production across regional events while playful mascot illustrations added a welcoming, school-spirited feel that drove engagement.

BEFORE
Gray bar instead of university colors Dense wall of intro text Cluttered signature block
AFTER
